documentation_track_note: The official API pages use rolling documentation. Production source is pinned above; live interoperability with that build remains to be demonstrated.
implemented_seam: Owner-authorized HTTPS HEAD and conditional ranged GET of explicitly selected /dav/spaces/{resourceID}/{path} files. Strong ETag, exact origin, byte and time bounds; no redirects.
proof_scope: Synthetic numeric-loopback HTTP contract tests only; not proof of live OpenCloud, core storage, or source-off access.
private_data: Bearer tokens, source file URLs and file bytes remain owner-private. Nothing in this adapter publishes public cache or training data.
redundancy: Not implemented or configured here; all applications must use the shared core-owned storage policy.
known_limits: No directory listing, upload, writable mount, Graph/OIDC replacement or native client integration.
No encrypted storage or second-device/server-off proof in this adapter.
An import sink must commit only after the complete byte stream succeeds.
OpenCloud rolling 7.5+ browser vaults are not a capability of this pinned stable 7.2.4 baseline.
